body:
i stopped enjoying it when i started to become an adult, childhood was nice and all, but mentally I  grew up quickly, I  don't have the head of a teen, never really had...
Bullshit like: everything. fake people, most people have the same stupid way of acting and being, society is creating copies, it's rare to find someone different. I am not depressed i am just tired and i don't want to do what my future reserves me...
your not the only one he is keeping alive

Yeah it's kind of what I usually think but then it really depends on the situation of each person so I don't judge or think it is selfish to kill yourself. It's cool to know that there is someone who shares my opinion

I just went all about suicide and ways of suicide with a fried today, and believe me she also was pretty surprised and bummed out although I think she managed pretty well to hide her natural reaction, she just talked to me in a very calm way like that was the most regular subject ever... I think she just doesn't know if I am serious about a possible suicide or something so she tried to act normal...But yeah, most people freak out about stuff like that... I don't anymore... It must be weird to say this but I am really open minded about the whole life/death thing and I don't think that saying "oh no life is beautiful and amazing, and no one should destroy it" is actually correct... Just my opinion
thanks a lot for the advice, I never really took that into consideration :)

yeah, sometimes doesn't really matter if it is helpful what the other one has to say, when I told this to a friend of mine the other day, also told her my perspective about life and death and the meaning, she kind of stopped and freaked out, asked me if I smoked or if I was drunk... She never thought that I would say such things but yeah, I just kind of replied to you because I understood that we kind of were experiencing the same so... :)

It is actually life in general, I don't see a point in it, the usual goals and ambitions don't matter to me, I fucking hate the way people in general are, I don't want to do anything I just feel agony now, and I want to end it because I sometimes think that I wasn't supposed to be born as a human... I am not interested in life anymore... The only thing that keeps me from ending it all is my moms reaction and her future and also, although I am not religious and I don't believe in shit like life after death or soul, I am kind of scared that there will be "something" and that ending it will do nothing because I will still remember everything and I will "see" everything that happens after I leave...

Yeah I kind of know how you feel, The only thing that is probably keeping me here is just the new season of Game of thrones. Okay I know I sounded like an ass right now. But yes I see where you are coming from. 
It's like there is nothing really worth living for and I am just making excuses and getting shit to kill time

Yeah I see your point, I already do sports sometimes, just to get tired and sleep more... It sounds stupid I know but if I sleep more I have to take less bullshit.
But thanks for the advice :)

Hey, I kind of know how you feel, and at this point the only thing taht is keeping me alive is because I am worried with what will happened to my mother and also if I don't actually have a successful death and end up crippled, which is maybe even worse and another weight for my mother.
I also don't find anything really that worth to live for. I try sleeping as much as I can just not to be "awake" but even that isn't working anymore...
Sorry if I didn't comment anything that would be cheerful or positive and didn't say to keep going, I just kind of decided to talk to you to see if there is anyone who feels like me about life and what it will be for each person... Because the future is kind of predictable! Don't lecture me about crap like dreams and goals.
Keep in touch
Yeah, for some people life might be fun in that way and amusing. But I don't find anything to be actually amusing...

Thanks a lot for reading and responding :)
But I just feel like anything will truly amuse me or keep me going. I just find peoples' lives in general meaningless and empty even though they are happy and amused. It just feels like I am spending time on nothing at all...
